card.name: Linking words before hormone or glucose terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words or verbs (of, including, to, the, -es) just before a physiological substance such as glucose, bradykinin, antidiuretic hormone or TSH, in drug interaction and warning sections.

modes.label: Link before hormone/glucose
modes.description: A preposition or verb right before a hormone or blood sugar term in an interaction or effect statement.
modes.example: 7.3 Anti-diabetic Agents Disturbances<< of>> blood glucose, including hyperglycemia

modes.label: Including before a peptide
modes.description: The word including introducing a list of body chemicals.

modes.label: Code explanation
modes.description: A rare case in programming documentation where 'to' introduces a purpose.
modes.example: salt is a 2-character string which will be used<< to>> select one of 4096

card.writes: It lowers the odds of the word token, so it mainly shifts output away from token-related continuations rather than adding clear content.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words right before a hormone or blood sugar term in drug effect sentences.
